sentences.en: Swimming will be the main event of the next Olympics.
sentences.zh: 游泳将是下一届奥运会的主要项目。

sentences.en: I run a lot as a method for the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 我跑步很多是为了参加奥运会做准备。

sentences.en: When did you decide to try out for the Olympics?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候决定要参加奥运会的试训的？
